problems: Municipality matching: the 2007-2009 and 2015-2021 tables number the 262 municipalities in the same order with the same department on every row, so rows were identified by number and named from the 2017 table. The 2002-2014 Epi Info tables use abbreviated or truncated names (e.g. "S FCO MENENDEZ", "STA ISABEL ISH"); these were expanded only where exactly one municipality fits. In some years the source lists the same municipality under two spellings (e.g. "NUEVA SAN SALVADOR" and "SANTA TECLA"; names entered with a leading space in 2002); both rows are kept and the smaller one is marked in breakdown. geoBoundaries ADM2 has no department attribute, so departments were assigned by which ADM1 polygon contains each municipality; Jerusalén, Sacacoyo, San Ildefonso and Meanguera del Golfo were matched by unique name across departments, Rosario de La Paz and Rosario (Cuscatlán) to the geoBoundaries features named "El Rosario" in La Paz and (by elimination) in Cabañas. The first-pass failures (datos.gob.sv refused by the proxy; old transparencia.gob.sv pages 404) still apply; the Órgano Judicial transparency portal (transparencia.oj.gob.sv) was reachable from the shell.
